notes.title: Update 102: Redesigned tools and various improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Update 102: [/h1]
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] No more picking up and throwing away tools: new shortcuts are available and they'll never leave your side!
[*] The dog no longer has the ability to fetch tools, but instead fetches your items when they are available after manufacture
[*] Mounts are no longer used to pick up tools
[*] The tutorial has been redesigned accordingly and is now shorter.
[*] The button to discard the tool has been replaced by "Mount" the mount
[*] All these changes are designed to take the frustration out of the game so that players can fully enjoy the experience.
[*] It is now possible to get the next day's calendar gift for 3 stars
[/list]

[h2]Improvements: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced size of action buttons on main interface
[*] Added color to action buttons depending on the action, as well as animation when these actions change (when picking up a new tool)
[*] Permanent display of mount pane
[*] Added "I don't need help" button for start-of-game dialog
[*] Animals now move forward and backward when giving or receiving a hit
[*] The camera that follows the character is a little further back by default to add comfort to the player
[/list]

[h2]Corrections :[/h2]
[list]
[*] The size of some texts has been reduced
[*] Improved game optimization on many points
[*] Horse trainer success has been corrected
[/list]

notes.title: Update 101: Player's choice: The battle tower
notes.content:
[h1]Update 101 : [/h1]
[h2]What's new? [/h2]
[list]
[*] A new tower is available in the town centre. It's home to some fearsome guardians, so get ready for the challenge! How far will you go to save the assistant?
[*] Five new achievements await the victorious players of the battle tower.
[*] Voting for the next in-game feature is now available.
[*] A new weekly or monthly event has been added (fight in a ranked game).
[*] Addition of a name change potion for animals.
[*] Players new to the game will get a seedling bonus of +50% plant growth speed.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements : [/h2]
[list]
[*] Animals now have a stat bonus at level 11, 21 and 31 (+5 attack, +5 defence and +10 HP per level). This change will create a gap between lower level animals with lower level animals to enhance the value of level progression.
[*] Player titles (earned via successes) are now correctly translated into French and English.
[*] The tips and tricks displayed during loading have been revised and others have been added.
[*] Slight increase in the volume of the character's footsteps.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes : [/h2]
[list]
[*] All data linked to an account is now correctly deleted when the account is deleted.
[*] Correction to the French translation of certain menus and buttons
[*] Fixed a bug that affected the size of the 3D model of animals in combat
[/list]

notes.title: Update 98: Auto planting function and improved character creation menu
notes.content:
[h1]Update 98 : [/h1]
[h2]New features : [/h2]
[list]
[*] New option to automatically plant vegetables and fruit whenever possible.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements: [/h2]
[list]

[*] The price of the tractor has been reduced from 1000 to 100 Nox, and beginners now have a quest to buy this vehicle at the end of the tutorial. This will allow new players to learn that vehicles exist.
[*] A number of major candy recipes have been revised to enhance the use of animal ingredients.
[*] The word “Elo” has been replaced by “ Rating” for greater clarity.

notes.title: Update 97: PvP balancing
notes.content:
[h1]Update 97[/h1]
[h2]New features : [/h2]
[list]
[*] A new button in the social menu lets you visit the farm of one of your Steam friends.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements: [/h2]
[list]
[*] The exchange rate between stars and jades has been changed from 1 star for 1 jade to 1 star for 4 jades (the rate was too expensive).
[*] The crafting time of a recipe is now displayed in preview, just like XP or durability when crafting an item.
[/list]
[h3]PvP balancing: [/h3]
[list]
[*] All support animals now have their defense reduced by 10, while their attack and HP increase by 5. This will make combat more dynamic for new players (especially with cows). 
[*] All attacking animals see their attack reduced by 10 and their HP increased by 10. Attacking animals do too much damage at low levels.
[/list]

[h2]Corrections:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could delete your team's PvP registration.
[*] Added a return to the farm when visiting the farm of a Steam friend who doesn't own a farm (not playing Farmer Toon).
[*] The “stop following” button now affects all animals following you.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from completing the tutorial in rainy weather.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 96: Player's choice: Farm visit!

[list]
[*] Ability to visit any other player's farm. In fact, when you leave the farm you'll be able to find a friend or inspiring player to visit their farm!

[list]
[*] In PvP, the top 50 players on the leaderboard are now displayed (instead of the top 20)

[*] PvP arena texture corrected (too reflective)
[*] Changed the price to unlock talents (300 instead of 500 jades and 600 instead of 1000 jades for tier 3 talents)
[*] A sound is now played when the player harvests a rare plant

[*] Fixed a bug that applied the elo stored in the matchmaking list to the opposing player (when there could be a discrepancy between his real elo and the stored elo). [h1]Update 90: PvP 5/5![/h1]

[h2]New features :[/h2]
[list]
[*] New “ranked game” button in the PvP menu.
[*] Fight history is displayed in the PvP menu (so you can see if other players are attacking you when you're offline).
[*] Two new items: battle tickets, a consumable for battles in ranked games, and jade stones, the PvP reward. These will be very useful in future updates.
[*] You can fight ranked players of your own level, and it's possible to refresh the list for free by waiting a while, or to refresh it instantly for a few stars.
[*] At the start of the season, there's a 10-fight bonus where players win and lose many more ranking points (Elo).

notes.title: Update Alpha V32 : Server reset and big changes
notes.content:
[h1]Reset server and big changes[/h1]
[h2]Level and XP implementation[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are now 15 levels
[*] Each level unlocks new plants/animals/buildings
[*] A new menu is available to track your progress
[*] Each action gives you XP to progress to the next level
[*] At level 10 you will choose between two options which will allow you to have access to a unique dish but you will not be able to produce the other dish
[/list]
[h2]Redesign professions[/h2]
[list]
[*] All players start with level 0 trades
[*] There is a new profession: "Maker".
[*] Doing an activity that matches the job gives XP in that job
[*] There are four levels to unlock new things with the professions
[*] Tier 1: trade items are cheaper
[*] Tier 6: +10% production speed for the trade
[*] Level 10: Access to rare items
[*] A new menu is available to track your progress
[/list]
[h2]Change in hunger mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] When the hunger bar is full the plants grow 25% faster
[*] When the hunger bar is at 0 the plants grow 25% slower
[*] No more fatigue that prevents the player from playing if the hunger bar is at 0
[*] When you put your mouse on the smiley below the hunger bar there is an explanation
[*] The design of the hunger bar has changed
[/list]
[h2]New system of buying and selling to non-player characters[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed all prices for plants and animals
[*] You can't buy items if their level is higher than yours
[*] When you sell to the non-player character he loses money until he can't buy your products anymore
[*] Non-player characters who sell have 1000 Nox per day to sell
[/list]
[h2]Redesign all recipes and foods[/h2]
[list]
[*] Recipe book only shows feasible items
[*] Ingredients can now be clicked on in the recipe book or in the buildings
[/list]
[h2]Redesigned bonuses[/h2]
[list]
[*] The bonus for each dish is unique and can be combined with other bonuses.
[*] These bonuses help your plants to grow faster
[*] Rolling your mouse over the bonus will recall the bonus
[*] The hardest dishes to make give a resistance bonus to the loss of hunger bar
[*] Bonuses are displayed in the top right corner of the screen
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reworked achievements to reflect new features
[*] Adjusting the tutorial to learn how to eat a dish
[*] Save the audio volume power
[*] No more non-player characters in town to change jobs
[*] Adjustment of the dishes that non-player characters sell in town
[*] Display the area around a plant or animal to have more info on the detection area
[*] There is now 1 food per animal with different recipes
[*] There is now 1 different oil per vehicle
[*] You are now slower when you plant or put something down
[*] There are now several different power fertilizers
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Default key to undo becomes Q (instead of A before)
[*] Fixed surface detection for animal and plant pose
[*] Correction of building and ploughed land pose (detection)
[/list]
